name: ColorOS and realme UI (OPPO, realme, OnePlus)

packages.label: Lock Screen Magazine
packages.reason: Rotating lock-screen pictures with story and promo links.

packages.label: Ad service (opos)
packages.reason: OPPO's ad platform, used for ads and ad click tracking in system apps.

packages.label: User Experience Program
packages.reason: Sends usage data to OPPO. Starts at boot and stays running.

packages.label: User Experience Program (newer)
packages.reason: The same usage-data service on newer ColorOS versions.

packages.label: Hot Apps
packages.reason: Fills the 'Hot Apps' and 'Hot Games' home-screen folders with sponsored apps.

packages.label: Instant games platform
packages.reason: Runs playable game ads and instant games without installing them.

packages.label: Instant games service
packages.reason: Local helper for the instant games platform.

packages.label: O Roaming
packages.reason: Sells paid roaming data plans. Roaming with your own SIM is not affected.

packages.label: System messages (HeyTap push)
packages.reason: Delivers promo 'system messages'. Some notifications from OPPO apps stop too.

packages.label: App Market
packages.reason: OPPO's app store. Sends app promos, but also updates some OPPO apps.

packages.label: App Market (older name)
packages.reason: The same app store under its older package name.

packages.label: Browser
packages.reason: Browser with ads and news notifications. Set another browser as default first.

packages.label: Theme Store
packages.reason: Themes, fonts and wallpapers with promos. You can't change themes while it is off.

packages.label: Games
packages.reason: Games hub with suggested games. Games still run; the in-game toolbar goes.

packages.label: Game Space
packages.reason: The older games hub. Games still run; the in-game toolbar goes.

packages.label: Shelf
packages.reason: The swipe-down cards panel with suggested content. Its widgets go with it.
